trial_court: IV Additional District Judge, Kakinada, East Godavari District, GWOP No.61 of 2019

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Respondent (wife) seeking custody of minor child

facts_of_case: Wife filed GWOP for custody of minor child born out of wedlock in USA; husband opposed and wife sought interim custody pending OP.

legal_principles.principle: A court may grant custody of a minor child to the person who has been taking care of it, even if that person is not the biological parent.
legal_principles.held: The court at Michigan examined all the material aspects of the minor child and granted custody to him.
applicable_acts_sections: Guardian and Wards Act (8 of 1890) — Section X

legal_principles.principle: A court may grant a reasonable time to the person who is required to bring a minor child from one country to another.
legal_principles.held: This court feels a reasonable time should be granted to the respondent and accordingly, three months time granted to the respondent to bring the child to India.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Section X

outcome.final_order: Interim custody of minor child granted to respondent with certain conditions.

keywords: Latin maxim: Filius nullius est, nisi per patrem
use_for_drafting: representing clients in Guardians and Wards Act cases
